semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides specialized equipment and application support for various semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Micro-Power Scientific (H.K.) Co. Ltd. offers a range of equipment and application support for semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on processes such as E-beam evaporation, thin film coating, and plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition. They also provide advanced tools for assembly and packaging, including wire bonding and bond testing equipment.
capabilities: Wire bonding machines (e.g., F&S 53xxBDA, F&S 5330, F&S 5350)
